problem_text:
A city planner must allocate the annual budget across 18 different infrastructure projects to maximize the overall public benefit score.  
The profile for each project is as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.149, impact factor 0.236, allocation limits [0.027, 0.641]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.121, impact factor 0.052, allocation limits [0.010, 0.460]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.137, impact factor 0.241, allocation limits [0.005, 0.851]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.112, impact factor 0.089, allocation limits [0.032, 0.684]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.050, impact factor 0.038, allocation limits [0.075, 0.522]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.168, impact factor 0.294, allocation limits [0.018, 0.767]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.077, impact factor 0.074, allocation limits [0.081, 0.707]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.162, impact factor 0.286, allocation limits [0.068, 0.551]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.088, impact factor 0.237, allocation limits [0.079, 0.575]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.194, impact factor 0.046, allocation limits [0.055, 0.563]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.065, impact factor 0.163, allocation limits [0.088, 0.512]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.069, impact factor 0.264, allocation limits [0.040, 0.581]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.116, impact factor 0.181, allocation limits [0.059, 0.472]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.143, impact factor 0.244, allocation limits [0.026, 0.872]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.093, impact factor 0.038, allocation limits [0.069, 0.612]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.079, impact factor 0.111, allocation limits [0.071, 0.731]  
* Project Q: benefit score 0.036, impact factor 0.176, allocation limits [0.066, 0.854]  
* Project R: benefit score 0.184, impact factor 0.092, allocation limits [0.014, 0.437]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified allocation limits, and the total allocation across all projects must equal the entire budget. To ensure timely completion, the subset of quick-delivery projects Q = {A, D, G, P, R} must collectively receive at least 0.269 of the total budget. Additionally, the total impact factor of the portfolio must not exceed 0.205, and the overall benefit score must be at least 0.093. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
